# maps/garrison.gd

Declarations come from source. Unannotated types are explicit; see the [system guides](../../../systems/README.md) for runtime schemas, nullability, ownership, units and side effects.

Inherits cast, rota, director, camera and night lifecycle from npc_showcase.gd.

Base: `not declared`. Registered class: `none`.

### _decal

```gdscript
func _decal(m: Dictionary) -> void
```

[Source:393](../../../../maps/garrison.gd#L393)

A decal marker made a Decal: its picture ("decal_<kind>": a photo, or
our own painting of the ground's soot, dirt, straw and leaves) projected
into the wall it faces (its -z), or straight down onto a floor, never onto
the men walking through it. Nothing when there is no picture (the
flat-colour fallback has no stains).

| Parameter | Type in source | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `m` | `Dictionary` | required |

### _god_rays

```gdscript
func _god_rays() -> void
```

[Source:482](../../../../maps/garrison.gd#L482)

God rays: a shaft of the moon's light in the glass's colours falling
steeply from each of the chapel's moonward lancets to its floor or its
walls. The coloured pools the glass throws (the window_shaft lights)
follow them: clouds and rain dim both, never put them out (the chapel is
never without them); lightning flares them.

Parameters: none.

Return type: `void`.
